name: Daily Ayah & Hadith
author: keyaypi
description: A rotating Qur'an ayah and hadith in the bar, with a panel for the full text, translation, reference and grading. 98 languages for the Qur'an, 9 for hadith, and it keeps working offline.

barWidget.description: A rotating ayah and hadith, with the full text in a panel.

schema.label: Translation language
schema.description: Language of the Qur'an translation. 98 are available. Pick it in the panel — the list comes from the API rather than from this file, so it never goes stale.

schema.label: Qur'an script
schema.description: Arabic edition slug, e.g. ara-quranuthmanihaf. Empty shows the translation alone.

schema.label: Hadith language
schema.description: Hadith translations exist in nine languages, and not every book in every one.

schema.label: Hadith in Arabic
schema.description: Optional Arabic edition of the same book, shown above the translation.

schema.label: Only show hadith graded
schema.description: Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim carry no grade strings because every hadith in them is authentic by construction; they are treated as sahih. A collection with no gradings at all ignores this filter and says so.

schema.label: Preferred grader
schema.description: When several scholars graded a hadith, this one decides. Leave empty to take the strictest verdict present.

schema.label: Choice
schema.description: Deterministic derives the pick from the clock and the settings, so every machine configured alike shows the same ayah. Random picks freely and avoids recent repeats.

schema.label: Plugin language
schema.description: Language for this plugin's own labels, which is a separate choice from the language of the translations. Auto follows the translation language when this plugin ships that locale, and English otherwise.
